publicationScope: Educational section and stress influence overlay; shaft and toe native D2 solver; exact self-weight effective lithostatic stress; approximate spread from native reactions. NO soil continuum FEM and NO NTC geotechnical ULS/SLS check.

cases.baselineMethod: Exact piecewise integrated layered effective vertical lithostatic stress from D2 geotech-piles.verticalStress
cases.influenceMethod: Approximate, illustrative regularized elastic load-spreading influence from actual D2 t-z shaft and q-z toe reactions; downward-only source superposition, not continuum 2D/3D FEM or a verified geotechnical stress result.
cases.sourceDomain: Axial pile force/settlement is a genuine DÈLGHEM D2 numerical t-z/q-z calculation. Overlay σ0 is a genuine D2 exact-layered lithostatic integral. Δσ is a transparent analytic approximation intended only to visualise pile load diffusion.
